title: Write Makefile for caliptra_test with hw-model backend
description: Create wolfcrypt/src/port/caliptra/sim/Makefile to build caliptra_test linked against the hw-model backend instead of caliptra_sim.c. Must link: libcaliptra_hw_model_c_binding.a (~/caliptra/target/debug/), libcaliptra.a (built from ~/caliptra/libcaliptra/), and the Rust system libs needed by the static library (pthread, dl, m). Include paths: ~/caliptra/hw-model/c-binding/out/ (for caliptra_model.h), ~/caliptra/libcaliptra/inc/ (for caliptra_api.h, caliptra_if.h, caliptra_types.h). Also needs wolfssl headers and caliptra_port.h.
